title: Differences in Employment and Salary Outcomes for Graduates from Different University Courses
what_it_is: Differences in Employment and Salary Outcomes for Graduates from Different University Courses

sections.label: ADM graduate employment and salaries
sections.summary: ADM graduates averaged about 88% employment over 10 years, with starting salaries rising about 3.4% yearly, and more freelancers and self-employed persons than other sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In the last 10 years, the average employment rate for ADM graduates was around 88% and the starting salary increased about 3.4% every year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The employment rate and salary level for fresh graduates in this sector are typically lower compared to their peers who join other sectors, such as engineering, built environment and business.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The nature of work and business structures in the ADM sector also mean that there is a higher proportion of freelancers and self-employed persons (SEPs) compared to other sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Under Our SG Arts Plan (2023-2027), the National Arts Council (NAC) is taking active steps to grow capabilities and excellence in the arts sector and support the training and development of SEPs.

sections.label: Health sciences graduate salaries
sections.summary: Health sciences graduate median salary growth over ten years was lower than other university graduates, but rose 6% in 2023, above the general average.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: As for health sciences graduates, while the growth in median salaries over the past ten years has been lower than the other graduates from the universities, it increased by 6% in 2023, which was higher than the average increase for university graduates in general.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) continues to work with healthcare clusters to review the starting salary and salary package of healthcare workers on a regular basis, to ensure that the salaries remain competitive.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOH also provided funding support to the community care sector over the last 10 years to uplift salaries and most recently, put out salary guidelines for the sector.

sections.label: Graduate employment destinations
sections.summary: Collected data shows many graduates go into public relations, product design, advertising, sales, marketing, graphic design and tourism.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: From the data that we have collected, many of them actually go into public relations, product design, advertising, sales, marketing, graphic design, tourism and many more.
